- Technical constraints: on-prem VPC option for PII, max sequence length ~2048 tokens, average doc size ~900 tokens.

Action items we agreed on:
1) I’ll share the short pilot scope (2-week perf + cost baseline) and a sample SOW.
2) Your team will confirm data access approach and any compliance gating items.
3) Tentative tech sync w/ Marcus (our SE) next week for environment/ingest plan.

Attachments: Acme-discovery-deck.pdf (high level), Acme-POC-scope.xlsx (pilot scope).

2) CS ask: Monica, would offering a 2-week pilot with a lightweight success criteria (99p latency under X ms / < $0.02/token) help accelerate momentum? If so, we should be ready with measurement plan + trial metrics.
3) Leadership/discount: Laura, if they ask for a pilot discount or credit to run perf cost comparisons, is there a quick approval bandwidth for a small credit?

Goal: get a 30-minute SE sync scheduled and then send a concise bump to Hanna that signals progress + a clear, low-effort ask from her (confirming priority + best contact for procurement).

I’m proposing this bump text (short):
"Hi Hanna — circling back on the pilot scope I sent. We can schedule a 30-min SE sync next week to walk through environment and measurement. Are you able to confirm whether this is still a priority for Q1 procurement? If yes, who on your side should I loop in for procurement details?"

Please reply with two quick bullets by EOD so I can finalize tomorrow AM.

Thanks — J

- Measurement: we’ll sample 5000 queries (representative mix) and provide a perf report + breakdown in the console.
- Commercial: we can offer a $5k pilot credit if Laura signs off — keeps financial ask minimal and shows skin in the game.

If Laura is OK with the credit, I’ll prepare a short SOW stub (SOW-stub.docx) and a one-page runbook for the pilot.
